name: Borja Giménez Larraz - Après le § 4 - Am 97
title: REPORT on the housing crisis in the European Union with the aim of proposing solutions for decent, sustainable and affordable housing
part_text: 4b. Calls on Member States, where appropriate, to introduce targeted incentives facilitating access to home ownership and supporting family formation, in particular for younger generations, including those under the age of 30; notes that such incentives may include financial instruments such as public guarantees, savings-based support schemes or temporary fiscal incentives for first-time buyers; underlines that access to credit for first-time buyers has been significantly constrained by cumulative prudential and macro-financial rules, and calls for their proportionate application to avoid excluding creditworthy households;
